notes: The two groups are intentional and are not a defect. The booklet builds two separate models: the airplane (steps 1-25, pages 4-20) and a stand-alone hand truck with a cargo box (page 3). The hand truck is never connected to the plane. It only stands beside it in the final picture, so no edge joins the two groups.
The minifigure (cap, head, torso, legs) is not in the parts list, so it is omitted.
Ports are mostly left null because the pictures don't show which studs line up. Stud-to-anti-stud joins are given at piece level.

Several placements are judgement calls from small isometric pictures: the red/yellow fuselage layering (steps 5-9, 16-20), where the cheese slopes sit, which pieces the three landing-gear holders clip to, and which piece the cockpit handle tile (b27) sits on.
Wheel holders and wing pods use attach overrides to reach different external parts.
The propeller is joined to the engine mount plate's axle-hole. No separate axle is in the parts list.
The roof (b57) and windscreen (b46) lift off together in step 25, so b57 is joined to the windscreen and only touches the tile on the windows.
The hand-truck cargo box rests on the frame (contact), and the box tile is pushed onto the brick.
The sticker sheet is joined to the tail fin only, though stickers also go on the fuselage.
